content.short: Cobo Argus simplifies DeFi workflows for Safe{Wallet} users with a single-signature module and DeFi bots for automated yield farming, leverage adjustment, and fund withdrawal.
content.description: Cobo Argus helps Safe{Wallet} users manage DeFi operations that typically require multiple signatures by introducing a single-signature module for improved risk control and clearer role delegation, which streamlines team workflows. It also addresses inefficiencies in manual DeFi trading and monitoring by providing DeFi bots for automated yield farming, leverage adjustments, and fund withdrawals. The bots are built with strong security in mind and leverage trusted security and tooling partners to ensure top-tier protection.
